captions.text: A Texas research project starts today.
The plan is to build digital twins for freshwater systems.
Sensor readings, weather and maintenance records would feed the model.
The goal is to anticipate failures that spread.
This is a research start, not a working utility rollout.
The award reports no measured service improvements.
The team plans tools and workshops for operators.
The real test still belongs at the pump.

retime_evidence._why: A cut is placed at the start of the line its scene carries. That word's time is measured when the reader paused before it and modelled by syllable weight when they did not, so this counts both rather than claiming all are measured.

documentary.viewer_question: Can a digital rehearsal expose a failure before it reaches the next connected asset?
documentary.payoff: The same pump stops, reveals its network, and separates into a proposed research twin.
documentary.source_limit: The award describes proposed research, not a deployed system or measured service improvement.
documentary.hero_image: One stopped physical rotor above a still-moving wireframe research twin.
documentary.closing_answer: The physical pump remains the test; the award does not establish a service improvement.

documentary_copy.source_limit: Research concept. No deployed result shown.

reference_only: September 15th footage and narration reused to test the production documentary renderer. Never reuse this topic as the next daily story.
